value.rationale: A geometrically ordinary large-automorphism genus-505 pencil has its first prime-field rational parameter obstruction at p23, quantified by exact ranks, despite 490 ordinary quadratic parameters. This sharp finite-field gap has a natural motivating ordinarity problem and a nontrivial polynomial root-cover certificate rather than a single arbitrary special curve.
